from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Distributed_Execute(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_distributed_execute"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("operations",                 "any")
        self.add_input("operations_json",            "string", widget_type="text",     default="[]")
        self.add_input("required_capabilities_json", "string", widget_type="text",     default="[]")
        self.add_input("transaction_name",           "string", widget_type="text",     default="distributed")
        self.add_input("dry_run",                    "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=False)
        self.add_input("rollback_on_error",          "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=True)
        self.add_output("ok",                  "bool")
        self.add_output("status",              "string")
        self.add_output("dispatch_id",         "string")
        self.add_output("worker_id",           "string")
        self.add_output("transaction_id",      "string")
        self.add_output("operations_executed", "int")
        self.add_output("errors",              "list")
        self.add_output("graph_diff",          "any")
        self.add_output("report_json",         "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        from src.runtime.distributed_runtime import get_distributed_runtime
        _empty = {
            "exec_out": True, "ok": False, "status": "error",
            "dispatch_id": "", "worker_id": "", "transaction_id": "",
            "operations_executed": 0, "errors": [], "graph_diff": {}, "report_json": "{}"
        }

        # Resolve operations from wire or JSON
        ops = inputs.get("operations")
        if not isinstance(ops, list):
            try:
                ops = json.loads(inputs.get("operations_json") or "[]")
            except Exception as exc:
                _empty["errors"] = [f"operations_json parse error: {exc}"]
                return _empty

        try:
            caps = json.loads(inputs.get("required_capabilities_json") or "[]")
        except Exception:
            caps = []

        if not isinstance(ops, list):
            _empty["errors"] = ["operations must be a list"]
            return _empty

        dr = get_distributed_runtime()
        try:
            result = await dr.dispatch_operations(
                operations=ops,
                required_capabilities=caps,
                transaction_name=str(inputs.get("transaction_name", "distributed")),
                dry_run=bool(inputs.get("dry_run", False)),
                rollback_on_error=bool(inputs.get("rollback_on_error", True)),
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            _empty["errors"] = [str(exc)]
            _empty["report_json"] = json.dumps({"error": str(exc)})
            return _empty

        return {
            "exec_out":            True,
            "ok":                  bool(result.get("ok", False)),
            "status":              str(result.get("status", "")),
            "dispatch_id":         str(result.get("dispatch_id", "")),
            "worker_id":           str(result.get("worker_id") or ""),
            "transaction_id":      str(result.get("transaction_id") or ""),
            "operations_executed": int(result.get("operations_executed", 0)),
            "errors":              list(result.get("errors", [])),
            "graph_diff":          result.get("graph_diff", {}),
            "report_json":         str(result.get("report_json", "{}")),
        }

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Distributed_Execute
